Yunyun is a fictional character who
 appears in the multi-media franchise "Execution Angel † Guiltina." She is a devilish denpa-type character
 who is popular among fans despite her antagonistic role.
 She first appeared in the 2003 PC version.
 Since then, she's appeared in other media, such as the 2005 OVA, and released CDs sung in character.

"Execution Angel † Guiltina" is a hybrid simulation game and visual novel developed by indie studio, Who You. It came out in 2003 for the PC. Its genre is an "apocalypse RPG where you execute the innocent." One of the characters, Yunyun, is a devil who works for the enemy organization. She has a habit of saying her own name.

A made-up word from "Execution Angel † Guiltina."\n After the release of the 2005 OVA, "Rim de Lacent" became a popular online catchphrase, with the anime fans on 666ch spreading it online. In 2005's "Popular Anime Phrases Awards," it came in second place. The director of the OVA explained that it means both, "Let's go to the fictional world" and "It's okay to run from reality."
